title:
$800,000:
*HDB, EC or resale condo?*

lines.say: You've got 800,000 dollars to spend. HDB, EC or resale condo? The rules decide more than the price.
Resale HDB: you can get grants, and your loan instalment is capped at 30% of income.
You'll live there at least 5 years before you can sell.
New EC: there's an income ceiling, the same 30% cap, and new sites need 10 years before you can sell.
Resale condo: no income ceiling, a 55% cap on all your debts, and no minimum stay.
But sell within 4 years and seller's stamp duty applies.
Not sure which fits you? Comment CHECK.

caption:
